headline: Rights Issue Announcement: Ducon Infratechnologies Issues 24.99 Crore Rights Shares at Re. 1 per Share
sum: Ducon Infratechnologies Limited announced on 19 August 2026 that its Board has decided to issue 24,99,42,758 rights equity shares of face value Re. 1 each at an issue price of Re. 1 per share, aggregating ₹24.99 crore. The rights issue is offered to all eligible equity shareholders as on the record date to strengthen the company's financial position and fund working capital and promoter loan repayment.
implication: Rights issue at par value (Re. 1) with 1:1.3 entitlement ratio (approximately 1 right for every 3.25 shares held by existing shareholders at 32.49 crore base), structured via section 62(1)(a) CA 2013 with board sub-delegation to Rights Issue Committee post-shareholder approval-procedurally routine but capital-constrained issuance reflective of weak equity valuation.
detail: <cite index="3-2,3-5">The board decided to issue 24,99,42,758 rights shares to strengthen the company's financial position and enhance financial flexibility; the net proceeds are proposed to be used for repayment of unsecured loans from Managing Director Arun Govil (up to ₹9.52 crore) and funding incremental working capital requirements (₹7.36 crore).</cite> <cite index="1-3,10-1">The company received in-principle exchange approvals from BSE and NSE on 6 August 2026 for the ₹25 crore rights issue.</cite> <cite index="47-7">The company filed a revised draft Letter of Offer on 12 June 2026.</cite>

structure.consideration: ₹24,99,42,758 (24,99,42,758 shares @ Re. 1 per share); issue at par value (face value Re. 1 = issue price Re. 1)
conditions: Board authorization on 12 June 2026 under section 62(1)(a) CA 2013
In-principle approval from BSE and NSE on 6 August 2026
Shareholder approval via extraordinary general meeting on 20 May 2026 (per search results, EGM was scheduled and held)
Rights Issue Committee to finalize record date, rights entitlement ratio, application period, and allotment timeline
Allotment only in dematerialized form; physical shareholders to provide demat account details
Entitlements must be exercised or renounced before issue closing date; lapse if not exercised
Letter of Offer to disclose issue price, rights ratio, record date, and application process
approvals: Board of Directors approval on 19 August 2026 (finalizing pricing and quantum)
Extraordinary General Meeting approval on 20 May 2026 (shareholder consent)
In-principle approval from NSE on 6 August 2026
In-principle approval from BSE on 6 August 2026
structure.novel: None; routine rights issue at par to fund promoter loan repayment and working capital. However, at-par issuance at Re. 1 per share (face value) in a company with market capitalization of ~₹110 crore and current share price ~₹3.40 suggests significant dilution; no use of Rights Issue Committee for pricing discretion departs from recent market practice.

triggers.note: Rights issue requires board authorization and shareholder approval; triggering document is board resolution of 19 Aug 2026 fixing pricing at par

triggers.law: SEBI LODR 2015, Regulation 30 / Chapter IV ICDR Regulations
triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure of rights issue terms (price, ratio, dates) to stock exchanges at least 3 working days before record date; filing in August fulfils this
Scrutinizer report on voting results of EGM required; company must submit proof of shareholder approval to exchanges
